verdict.rationale: Undermind is a SaaS research service that offers programmatic API access and a hosted MCP server, so API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. The pack, however, has no evidence of versioned API endpoints or any documented deprecation policy. The "v1" mention refers to the search engine, not an API version, and probes for an OpenAPI spec returned 404 at every candidate path.
